name: Tailored Sleeveless Long Dress
description:
Eclose by Iro is a masterfully tailored long dress, exuding an air of understated sophistication. Crafted from an exceptionally soft, supple fabric with a delicate sheen, this silhouette-skimming piece gently caresses the contours of the body. The halter neckline with a tastefully rounded edge elegantly highlights the shoulders and elongates the neck, while refined draping at the waist subtly enhances the figure and radiates poise.

The absence of visible embellishments or logos accentuates the dress’s purity of form, allowing the artistry of Parisian-inspired minimalism to take center stage. Minimal yet captivating, the Eclose dress is the epitome of modern luxury—sensual, versatile, and impeccably constructed.

name: High-waisted Mid-Length Skirt with Slit
description:
Introducing the Emeraude skirt by Iro—an exquisite interpretation of modern Parisian chic. This mid-length skirt gently tapers along a refined silhouette, finishing with a subtly asymmetrical hem; the front is elegantly shorter than the back, creating a dynamic yet sophisticated effect. The high waist, adorned with delicate ruching and gathering, sculpts and flatters the form while lending dimensional elegance to the design.

Crafted from a soft, lightly lustrous, and gently stretchable fabric, the Emeraude skirt drapes gracefully, ensuring both comfort and luxurious wear. Its smooth, unembellished surface exudes understated sophistication, with the artistic draping at the waist and hips serving as the signature embellishment.

name: Straight-Leg Silhouette Trousers
description:
Elevate your wardrobe with these timeless tailored trousers, designed for a sleek and polished look. Crafted with a clean, structured silhouette, they feature a flattering high-rise waistband and sharp front pleats that create a refined, elongating effect. The straight-leg cut ensures versatility, making them perfect for both professional settings and elevated everyday wear.
Made from a smooth, high-quality fabric, these trousers offer comfort without compromising on style. Pair them effortlessly with a crisp shirt for the office or a relaxed knit for a modern, off-duty outfit.

name: Python-Printed Wide Leg Jeans
description: Wide-leg jeans. Faded python print each pair is one-of-a-kind. 5 pockets and a zip and button closure.

name: Wide-Leg High-rise Classic Trousers
description:
The Kalei wide-leg trousers by Iro epitomize an interplay of Parisian sophistication and modern flair. Constructed from a luxuriously smooth fabric—a refined wool blend—these formal trousers drape with effortless elegance, reflecting Iro’s devotion to exquisite tailoring.

The high-rise silhouette is accentuated by front pleats, adding sculptural volume and a striking, geometric touch. A deep charcoal gray hue, punctuated by narrow, vertical light pinstripes, elevates the classic wide-leg design with understated distinction. The waistband boasts elongated, avant-garde elements, imparting a unique designer signature, while side slit pockets and rear welt pockets offer refined practicality

name: Denim Printed Tank Top
description: MEDUSA denim crop top. Faded python print with each piece being unique. Thin and adjustable leather straps and a discreet fastening with invisible press studs on the side.

name: Long Printed Classic Coat
description:
Discover the epitome of refined sophistication with the 'Iglia' Coat by Iro – a distinguished creation from the acclaimed Parisian maison founded by Arik and Laurent Bitton. This long, classic overcoat boasts a relaxed silhouette and gently broadened shoulders, artfully complemented by traditional lapels, lending an air of enduring elegance.

Exquisitely tailored from a sumptuous blend of premium acrylic, wool, alpaca, cotton, polyamide, and polyester, the fabric’s rich, melange tweed structure in brown is beautifully interwoven with black and white threads, creating a striking, irregular pattern reminiscent of artisanal craftsmanship. The robust textile is ideally suited to the autumn and winter seasons, offering warmth as well as a tactile sense of luxury.

Impeccable details, such as two horizontal flap pockets and a single-breasted button fastening, evoke minimalist chic while ensuring practical elegance. This statement piece artfully channels the effortless Parisian flair for which Iro is celebrated.

name: Short Leather Jacket with Pockets
description:
Presenting the Dunea Leather Jacket by Iro—a statement piece that redefines contemporary sophistication. This jacket boasts a short, loosely tailored silhouette with accentuated shoulders and a tapered hem, underscored by a broad, ruched elastic band for an effortlessly modern, oversized effect. Crafted from premium lamb leather with a subtle luster, its smooth, monochromatic finish exudes minimalist elegance.

Signature design elements include a full-length metal zipper with a prominent leather pull, two generously sized flap patch pockets at the chest, and wide sleeves narrowed at the wrists with polished zip closures. The back features two decorative buckle straps and intricate stitched detailing at the hem, emphasizing its refined, structured fit. Lined with breathable viscose, this jacket harmonizes elevated design with everyday comfort, embodying Iro's Parisian-inspired flair.

Understated and contemporary, this model will become a real all-purpose staple in your wardrobe.

description: Trousers made of taffeta-like technical canvas, with side inserts made of organza ripstop for a combination of strength and transparency. This garment features an adjustable drawstring at the leg hem, two side pockets, two back patch pockets and two workwear-effect pockets with flap and press studs down the legs. A versatile, modern garment that reinterprets the streetwear spirit with a PINKO twist.

name: Asymmetric Pencil Satin Skirt
description: Pencil skirt featuring a special asymmetrical cut with a dramatic effect, accentuated by the waistband that falls in delicate flounces at the sides. The model is made from soft, radiant double-faced satin for a refined, even look both inside and out, and features a comfortable invisible zip fastening on the side to enhance the wear without sacrificing the fluidity of the silhouette. Perfect for elegant occasions or a sophisticated daytime outfit, this skirt pairs beautifully with a silk shirt or minimalist top, completing the look with a pair of bolder slingbacks or classic pumps.

name: Slim-Fit Midi Dress With Jewel Embroidery
description: A tank top with a wide round neckline, crafted from viscose crepe with a fluid, flowing hand. This piece is a true gem, thanks to its distinctive pinstripe-inspired design, achieved by alternating small cube-shaped metal elements and hand-embroidered crystals. Thanks to its versatile yet elegant design, it's the perfect under-jacket paired with tailored trousers, but also with a special pair of jeans.

name: Silk Organza Cropped Jacket
description: Cropped pea coat in pure silk organza, a fabric with a dry, crisp feel that perfectly combines the technical component and refined sensuality. Lightweight and sheer, the garment does not compromise on functional details, such as the stand-up collar with button, shoulder tabs, two large front patch pockets with flaps, buttoned cuffs, and a front button fastening. The ideal outerwear to express your femininity with original overlays and combinations in pure PINKO style

name: Midi Wrap Dress With Belt
description: Midi dress with small cap sleeves, made from panama fabric reminiscent of rustic linen for an elegant, relaxed look. Boasting a slim-fitting sheath silhouette and convenient rear zip fastening to help put it on, this style has a wrap-around design, elegant front pleats, a faux pocket on the left side and a plunging V-neck with jacket-like lapel collar. Completing this dress, ideal for a cocktail party or an evening date, are the central slit at the back and removable waist belt embellished with gold-coloured eyelets and buckle.

This garment features a single-breasted one-button fastening, classic lapels, two refined welt pockets and pleats at the front and back that shape the waist. The ton sur ton lining made of pure cotton ensures greater comfort when worn. Wear this jacket with the matching skirt for a feminine head-to-toe look ideal for formal occasions

description: Cropped sleeveless top in pure cotton poplin, featuring a soft flounce at the hem, a deep V-neck at the front and back, and thin ribbons to be tied behind the neck for customised styling. Featuring a side zip fastening to make it easy to put on, the garment is enhanced by all-over broderie anglaise detailing that creates an elegant geometric interplay of full and openwork embroidery, and is equipped with an inner cotton lining at the bodice to attenuate the sheer effect. This garment, destined to become your all-purpose pair for various occasions, combines style and comfort.

name: Semi-lined Cotton Trousers With Openwork Motif
description: Semi-lined pure cotton poplin trousers with refined welt pockets and a hidden side zip. This garment, with a wide-leg design, is enhanced by broderie anglaise detailing all over, creating an elegant geometric interplay of full and openwork embroidery. This garment is ready to embellish your summer outfits, combining style and comfort.

name: Denim Jeans With Lace Side Band
description: Trousers in lightweight black pure cotton denim with slightly flared legs. The functionality of the garment, provided by the elasticated waist and rear welt pockets, is enhanced by lace bands down the outer sides for a refined PINKO-signature touch. Completing the model is a small metal appliqué with the Love Birds logo on one of the back pockets. Pair these bottoms with a white shirt for an elegant look, or wear them with a T-shirt for a casual outfit.

name: Sleeveless Denim Top With Scarf Print
description: Sleeveless top with halterneck fastened with two ribbons that tie at the rear and cut-out in the form of an inverted triangle at the top of the back. What makes this garment really stand out is its two-sided character: the front side is more feminine and delicate thanks to the fluid viscose twill and refined scarf-inspired print, while the rear side has a more modern, laid-back look provided by the lightweight denim fabric with slight fading. This fresh, original top is ideal for even the hottest days, without sacrificing style: try it with a wide skirt and pair of slip-ons and get ready to welcome summer!

name: Straight Leg Jeans With Contrasting Fold-Down Waist
description: Women's five-pocket jeans with a wide, straight leg and a fixed turn-up hem. This garment is made from pure cotton denim with a super-bleached wash to obtain a pristine white shade all over, except for the inside of the waist and leg cuffs, which provide contrasting colour as a result. Thanks to the shorter zip, inner hook and press stud, this model be worn two ways: with a regular rise for a more classic look, or with a low rise with the waistband turned down for a touch of that PINKO-signature refined originality. Iconic brand hallmarks give the design a custom touch: a laser-cut Love Birds logo on one of the rear pockets and PINKO logo lettering on the inside of the waist at the back.

name: Asymmetrical Ruffled Camisole Top
description: A stylish one-shoulder top featuring gathered, ruffled details, often listed as the "Susie Top" or "Ruffled one-shoulder top". It typically features an asymmetric design, a thin strap

This garment features a gathered bottom hem embellished with small metallic spheres that create a refined interplay between the matte finish of the fabric and the sheen of the metal. The final touch is given by the label with PINKO logo lettering on the back. Pair this top with pieces in the same colour for a comfy and original head-to-toe look during your free time.

name: Sleeveless Ribbed Knit Polo Top

This style features a refined stand-up collar that ties at the front in a bandana style and a front fastening with buttons. The final touch is given by the label with jacquard PINKO logo lettering on the back. A versatile piece that is easy to wear with a pair of jeans or layer under a jacket for a casual look.

name: Long Ribbed Dress With Bandana Collar
description: Long dress with close-fitting yet comfortable silhouette elevated by its glossy ribbed fabric. Boasting a sleeveless design, this model features central button fastening on the front of the bodice, a flowing skirt with a wavy-effect hem, and a truly eye-catching, slightly raised collar with bandana-inspired strips that can either be tied into a basic knot for a fresh look or into a bow for a more feminine result. The final touch is given by the label with PINKO logo lettering on the back.

name: Long Slip Dress With Rhinestones
description: Long slip dress with spaghetti straps, loose neckline with draping at the front and back-revealing wide round neckline at the rear, punctuated only by two ribbons that tie in the middle. Made from georgette fabric with a refined matte finish, which delicately caresses the body and delivers a light, fluid silhouette, this model is embellished with shiny rhinestones dotted all over in a way that encapsulates PINKO's DNA as a brand. Feminine but with bold character, this dress is destined to become the star or your looks for special evenings and exclusive ceremonies.

To vary your look, wear the lavallière collar tied for a dandy twist, or remove it for a clean, timeless silhouette. Pair it with shorts and boat shoes to reinvent the codes of urban chic.

Pair it with an embroidered flared skort, platform loafers, a Miss M Mini bag and a knotted scarf for an assertive and resolutely Parisian look.
